title: MEG component diagram
description: MEG is one static page; the only things outside it are the fonts it loads and the browser storage it keeps progress in.

components.name: MEG page
components.responsibility: The whole game in index.html: input, simulation of the shark and the eight levels, canvas drawing, synthesized audio, HUD and menu screens.

components.name: Google Fonts
components.responsibility: Serves Press Start 2P, Special Elite and VT323 for the menus, the incident files and the HUD.

components.name: Browser localStorage
components.responsibility: Keeps the highest incident file reached and the sound setting on this device.

relationships.description: Loads the three fonts with a stylesheet link; falls back to system fonts without them.
Reads and writes meg.unlocked and meg.muted, and plays on without them if storage is blocked.
